summary: A dark synth firmware for dungeon synth and old JRPG dungeon music, forked from GHOULBOX on Felucca and keeping its four-track sequencer, songs and effects. Tested on one FM-1.
features: Five power-on scenes: LABYRINTH, RUINS, SHRINE, GOTHIC and BLANK
Bytebeat and floatbeat waves for the LOFI engine, 32 formulas each
Engine pages draw creatures that react to filter, detune and level
'COVEN' home screen with one creature per track
Inherits GHOULBOX's hurdy-gurdy, drone latch, DREAM generator, web editor
SLICE engine removed; projects using it won't play it

headings: fiendbox: a demon synth for the m-vave fm-1
